text:
Alice (Support): FYI customer AcmeCorp reporting sharp tail latency and intermittent 5xxs on /v1/generate. Started ~14:02 UTC. p95/p99 both spiking, customers seeing timeouts. Ticket #SUP-8123. Logs attached below.

Carla (CS): On a live call with them now — they hit user-visible timeouts (~10% of requests) and are throttling traffic client-side. Need quick mitigation, they asked for ETA.

Alice (Support): sample error from their side: `HTTP 503 {"error": "server_busy"}` and our proxy shows occasional `429` too. They said this started right after ~13:55 when a batch job kicked off on their side.

Rahul (SRE): digging into metrics. Pushing graphs now. Initial reads: p95 baseline ~220ms, p95 now ~920ms; p99 baseline ~650ms, p99 now ~2400ms. Queue depth for pool inference-gpu-3 peaked at 180 (SLO target 50). Worker CPU in that pool is pegged at 92-96% and context-switches high.

Izzy (Eng Runtime): checking recent deploys — we did a small runtime change at 13:45 that adjusted continuous-batching window from 20ms -> 200ms for throughput optimization (rollout to 25% of pods). That can increase batch accumulation under bursty traffic and cause head-of-line blocking for long-sequence requests.

Rahul (SRE): correlation looks strong: the latency tail increase matches the rollout timeframe and the tenant (acme-corp) shows a burst of long-sequence requests (seq_len ~3500) which amplify GPU time and block small requests in the same batch.

Izzy (Eng Runtime): proposed immediate actions:
- rollback cont-batching change for affected pool (fast rollback only).
- enable per-tenant admission control to cap inflight per-tenant to avoid head-of-line.
- apply a temporary tenant-level rate limit on acme-corp.

Rahul (SRE): executing now: scaling up inference-gpu-3 pool and applying tenant rate-limit 25 req/s.

```
# admin commands
rbctl scale --pool inference-gpu-3 --replicas 12
rbctl admission set --pool inference-gpu-3 --max-inflight-per-tenant 20
rbctl quota set --tenant acme-corp --rate 25/s
```

deploy-bot: rollback cont-batching v2 -> v1 at commit abc123 (initiated by Izzy)

ops-bot: autoscale action completed: inference-gpu-3 replicas 8 -> 12 (reason: manual override by rahul.sre)

Alice (Support): told customer we're applying controls (rate-limit + pool scale) and will monitor for 10m. They appreciate the quick action.

Izzy (Eng Runtime): quick post-change metrics: after rollback + scale + rate-limit (10m window) — p95 ~260ms, p99 ~720ms, queue depth back down to ~40, error rate dropped to <1%. Not fully back to baseline but much better.

Rahul (SRE): logged follow-up: ENG-1234 (investigate batching thresholds and per-tenant fairness), added runbook updates for cont-batching rollouts and a canary that includes a synthetic long-seq workload.

Carla (CS): customer is stabilized, asked for weekly update. Scheduling a post-incident call.

Izzy (Eng Runtime): long-term actions:
- add tenant-aware batching isolation (bulkheads) so long-seq requests don't block small ones.
- instrument per-tenant queue depth and head-of-line metrics in Console (alerts at >30 queued).
- change rollout flag to 10% with synthetic traffic gating for runtime batching changes.

Rahul (SRE): immediate mitigation checklist we used (for runbook):
- identify heavy tenant via metrics/trace (top by token-time).
- apply per-tenant rate limit + max-inflight.
- scale GPU pool (autoscale override).
- rollback recent batching/merge changes if correlated.
- enable fallback to smaller model variant for offending tenant if available.

Alice (Support): closing loop with customer now. They asked if we can auto-fallback to smaller model for spikes — noted as part of ENG-1234.

Carla (CS): :thumbsup: Great coordination. Filing customer follow-up notes into SUP-8123 and linking ENG-1234.

Rahul (SRE): will run a short blameless postmortem, timeline & actions in 24h.

Izzy (Eng Runtime): adding an immediate guard: `fast-fail` for request token_count > 4096 to return 413/429 instead of queuing. Will gate behind a FeatureFlag for 1h.

deploy-bot: featureflag fast-fail-longseq toggled ON for inference-gpu-3 (by izzy.runtime)

Rahul (SRE): final check — p95 steady ~270ms, p99 ~750ms after 25m. Marking incident as mitigated, tracking ENG-1234 for durable fixes.

Alice (Support): thanks team — customer updated and happy for now. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
